editorial_excerpt_zh: 马赛之家首次展出阿道夫·德·迈耶重新发现的威尼斯摄影集。自2026年10月24日至2027年2月7日，马赛之家将[…] 本文《马赛之家：阿道夫·德·迈耶：威尼斯之梦的实质》最先发表于The Eye of…
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "马赛之家首次展出阿道夫·德·迈耶（Adolphe de Meyer）重新发现的威尼斯摄影集。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "自2026年10月24日至2027年2月7日，马赛之家将举办“阿道夫·德·迈耶：威尼斯之梦的实质”，这是欧洲首个专门为摄影师阿道夫·德·迈耶（1868–1946）举办的博物馆展览。此前，2019年在图尔市立图书馆有一项引人注目的发现：一组75张照片，记录了他在威尼斯的生活与摄影工作。这批藏品将首次完整展出，让人难得一窥他的个人世界与艺术世界。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "时尚摄影先驱阿道夫·德·迈耶1868年生于巴黎，在欧洲和美国都拥有引人入胜且开创性的职业生涯。如今，历史学家主要将他视为画意摄影摄影师（这一运动将摄影视为一种艺术形式）、技艺精湛的肖像摄影师，而最重要的是时尚摄影师。他是最早将时尚摄影提升到艺术高度的人之一，为《Vogue》《Vanity Fair》和《Harper’s Bazaar》的版面创作优雅影像。鲜为人知的是，他还是室内装饰师、设计师、艺术收藏家、记者和作家。他把自己的整个生活变成了一件艺术品，其中摄影、服装、室内与场景布置表达出一致的艺术视野：一个不断重塑自我与周遭环境的人。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "环球旅行者旅行是他持续而宝贵的灵感来源，通常由妻子兼创作伙伴奥尔加（Olga）陪伴。日本是他早期的挚爱，随后是中国、印度和南美洲。德·迈耶把世界当作自己的实验场，也证明自己能够把工作室里一丝不苟的精确性用于工作室之外的摄影工作。尽管职业生涯极为成功且影响深远，他在1946年于洛杉矶去世时却几乎无人知晓。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "威尼斯之梦威尼斯在他心中占有特殊位置。1904年至1908/09年间，阿道夫和奥尔加租下了巴尔比-瓦利耶宫（Palazzo Balbi-Valier），这座17世纪的华丽宫殿被花园环绕，德·迈耶将这座破败建筑改造成地标性景点，导游和贡多拉船夫都会向游客指点它。这座宫殿是一个充满活力的文化中心，宾客包括摄影师格特鲁德·凯塞比尔（Gertrude Käsebier）和弗朗西丝·本杰明·约翰斯顿（Frances Benjamin Johnston）以及艺术收藏家伊莎贝拉·加德纳（Isabella Gardner）；德·迈耶还邀请奥古斯特·罗丹（Auguste Rodin）来此工作。巴尔比-瓦利耶宫首先是他工作室的延伸，他在那里试验光线、场景布置和早期彩色摄影，发展出一种将深刻影响其作品与时尚视野的美学。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展览通过8个不同主题探索他的生活、作品、艺术网络及其工作的诸多面向，从时尚摄影、室内设计到艺术收藏，以及他与奥尔加的特殊关系。参观者将获得难得的机会，发现这位开创性时尚摄影师背后的部分秘密，以及那座终生点燃他想象力的城市。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展览标题源自德·迈耶1916年发表于《Vogue》的一篇文章《威尼斯之梦的实质》，他在文中回顾了自己在这座城市的岁月。马赛之家最近购得的那一期《Vogue》也将在展览中展出。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "奥尔加：伴侣与神话在德·迈耶的生活与作品中，没有哪位女性比他妻子奥尔加更重要。奥尔加本名唐娜·玛丽亚·比阿特丽斯·奥尔加·阿尔伯塔·卡拉乔洛（Donna Maria Beatrice Olga Alberta Caracciolo，1871–1931）。她是同代人中最具魅力、最特立独行的女性之一，曾启发约翰·辛格·萨金特（John Singer Sargent）、詹姆斯·麦克尼尔·惠斯勒（James McNeill Whistler）和作家亨利·詹姆斯（Henry James）等艺术家。他们持续三十多年的非传统婚姻，被同时代人怀着着迷与钦佩看待。两人都是同性恋，他们的结合被视为权宜婚姻：在同性恋仍是社会禁忌的时代，这提供了社会合法性与保护。奥尔加不断为德·迈耶的相机做模特，穿他设计的服装，并共同组织巩固他们声誉的社交与文化活动。在创造力与自我塑造的驱动下，他们共同构建了一种共享身份，从而创造出一个神话。德·迈耶始终未能完全从奥尔加1931年去世的打击中恢复：尽管后来卖掉了大量作品，他始终保留着她的肖像，她也继续启发着他。她是他写作中的核心人物，尤其是在他未出版的自传体小说《激情与温柔》（Of Passion and Tenderness）中。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "一项引人注目的发现2019年，图尔市立图书馆的阿娜伊斯·阿尔洛（Anaïs Arlot）在清点当地收藏家保罗·卡龙（Paul Caron，1918–1988）的遗产时，发现了一批75张照片，似乎可归于阿道夫·德·迈耶名下。随后，刚出版过一本关于这位艺术家旅行摄影著作的卡米尔·莫娜·佩桑（Camille Mona Paysant）受邀确定这些照片的归属，并对这批作品进行研究。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "出版物展览配有一本新书《阿道夫·德·迈耶：威尼斯之梦的实质》，收录卡米尔·莫娜·佩桑的文章，她也是马赛之家此次展览的策展人。该书由恩斯特·格奥尔格·屈勒（Ernst Georg Kuehle，来自Kuehle und Moser）设计，为英法双语版。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "策展人：卡米尔·莫娜·佩桑", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Adolphe de Meyer：The Substance of a Venetian Dream 2026年10月24日至2027年2月7日 Huis Marseille，摄影博物馆 Keizersgracht 401 1016 EK Amsterdam, NL www.huismarseille.nl", "translated": true}]
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Huis Marseille presents a premiere of Adolphe de Meyer ’s rediscovered collection of photographs of Venice."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "From 24 October 2026 until 7 February 2027 Huis Marseille will be hosting Adolphe de Meyer. The Substance of a Venetian Dream , the first ever European museum exhibition devoted to the photographer Adolphe de Meyer (1868–1946). This follows the remarkable discovery in 2019 in the municipal library of Tours: a series of 75 photographs documenting his life and photographic work in Venice. This collection is being displayed in its entirety for the first time, and offers an exceptional glimpse into his personal and artistic world."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "A pioneer of fashion photography Adolphe de Meyer was born in Paris in 1868 and enjoyed a fascinating and ground-breaking career in both Europe and the United States. Historians recognise him today principally as a pictorialist photographer (a movement that approached photography as an art form), as a virtuoso portraitist, and above all as a fashion photographer. article_text:
Huis Marseille presents a premiere of Adolphe de Meyer ’s rediscovered collection of photographs of Venice.

From 24 October 2026 until 7 February 2027 Huis Marseille will be hosting Adolphe de Meyer. The Substance of a Venetian Dream , the first ever European museum exhibition devoted to the photographer Adolphe de Meyer (1868–1946). This follows the remarkable discovery in 2019 in the municipal library of Tours: a series of 75 photographs documenting his life and photographic work in Venice. This collection is being displayed in its entirety for the first time, and offers an exceptional glimpse into his personal and artistic world.

A pioneer of fashion photography Adolphe de Meyer was born in Paris in 1868 and enjoyed a fascinating and ground-breaking career in both Europe and the United States. Historians recognise him today principally as a pictorialist photographer (a movement that approached photography as an art form), as a virtuoso portraitist, and above all as a fashion photographer. He was one of the first to elevate fashion photography to artistic heights, creating elegant images for the pages of Vogue , Vanity Fair and Harper’s Bazaar . It is less well known that he was also an interior decorator, designer, art collector, journalist and writer. He turned his whole life into a work of art, in which photography, clothing, interiors and stagings expressed a coherent artistic vision: that of a man continuously reinventing himself and his surroundings.

Globetrotter His travels were a constant and invaluable source of inspiration, usually in the company of his wife and creative partner Olga. Japan was an early love, followed by China, India and South America. De Meyer made the world his field of experimentation, and he also proved able to apply the meticulous precision of his studio to the photographic work done outside his atelier. Despite a remarkably successful and influential career he was almost unknown when he died in Los Angeles in 1946.

A Venetian dream Venice had a special place in his heart. Between 1904 and 1908/09 Adolphe and Olga rented the Palazzo Balbi-Valier, an opulent 17th-century palace surrounded by gardens, that De Meyer transformed from a dilapidated building into a landmark attraction that was pointed out to tourists by tour guides and gondoliers. The Palazzo was a vibrant cultural centre, whose guests included the photographers Gertrude Käsebier and Frances Benjamin Johnston and the art collector Isabella Gardner; De Meyer also invited Auguste Rodin to come and work there. Palazzo Balbi-Valier was first and foremost an extension of his studio, where he experimented with light, staging, and early colour photography, developing an aesthetic that would strongly influence his work and fashion vision.

Through eight different themes the exhibition explores his life, work, artistic network, and the many facets of his work, from fashion photography and interior design to art collection, as well as his special relationship with Olga. Visitors will have a rare opportunity to discover some of the secrets behind this ground-breaking fashion photographer, as well as the city that fired his imagination throughout his life.

The title of the exhibition is derived from an article that De Meyer published in Vogue in 1916, ‘The Substance of a Venetian Dream’, in which he reflects on his years in the city. A copy of this particular edition of Vogue , which Huis Marseille recently acquired, is also on show in the exhibition.

Olga: partner and myth No woman played a more important role in De Meyer’s life and work than his wife Olga, born Donna Maria Beatrice Olga Alberta Caracciolo (1871–1931). She was one of the most charismatic and idiosyncratic women of her generation, who inspired artists such as John Singer Sargent, James McNeill Whistler and the writer Henry James. Their unconventional marriage, which lasted for more than three decades, was regarded by their contemporaries with fascination and admiration. Both were homosexual, and their union was considered a marriage of convenience: it offered social legitimacy and protection in an age when homosexuality was a social taboo. Olga constantly modelled for De Meyer’s camera, wore his designs, and co-organised the social and cultural events that cemented their reputations. Driven by creativity and self-invention they built a shared identity together, thereby creating a myth. De Meyer never fully recovered from Olga’s death in 1931: although he later sold a great deal of work, he always kept her portraits, and she continued to inspire him. She was a central figure in his writings, particularly in his unpublished autobiographical work of fiction Of Passion and Tenderness .

A remarkable discovery In 2019, while conducting an inventory of the estate of local collector Paul Caron (1918–1988), Anaïs Arlot of the Bibliothèque municipale de Tours uncovered a collection of seventy-five photographs that appeared to be attributable to Adolphe de Meyer. Camille Mona Paysant, who had recently published a book on the artist’s travel photography, was subsequently invited to establish the photographs’ attribution and conduct a study of the corpus.

Publication The exhibition is accompanied by a new book, Adolphe de Meyer. The Substance of a Venetian Dream , containing an article by Camille Mona Paysant, who also curated the exhibition in Huis Marseille. The publication was designed by Ernst Georg Kuehle (of Kuehle und Moser) in a bilingual (English/French) edition.

Curated by Camille Mona Paysant

解説・あらすじ

大阪の不動産デベロッパー社長・山岸忍が自身の身に起きた実際の事件をつづった書籍「負けへんで！ 東証一部上場企業社長 vs 地検特捜部」を、「空飛ぶタイヤ」の本木克英監督のメガホンで実写映画化。身に覚えのない罪で逮捕・勾留され、一代で築き上げた会社も失った主人公が、最強弁護士軍団と共に司法の闇に立ち向かう姿を描く。 不動産デベロッパーの社長を務める藤堂繁は、社員に慕われながら多忙な日々を過ごしていた。2019年、藤堂は3年前の学校土地の買収について、関西地検から事情聴取の呼び出しを受ける。検事の鈴鳴はフレンドリーに藤堂に接するが、48日後、彼は30億円の業務上横領の罪で逮捕されてしまう。すでに逮捕されている学校の理事長と、藤堂の部下・木下と共謀した容疑がかけられたのだ。拘置所に収監された藤堂は、自らが一代で築き上げた会社を守るため、社長を退任する。絶望する藤堂のもとに届いた恋人・美奈からの手紙には、彼を支える覚悟と「負けないで！」という言葉がつづられていた。冤罪を晴らすべく戦う覚悟を決めた彼は、元検事・元判事・刑事弁護の専門家・企業法務の専門家が集まった最強の弁護士チームと共に逆襲を開始する。 内野聖陽が藤堂繁役で主演を務め、藤堂を追い詰める検事・鈴鳴通子役で松本若菜、藤堂の無実を信じて支え続ける友人・君塚大作役で北村一輝、冤罪を晴らすため奔走する弁護士役で竜星涼、石丸幹二、藤本隆宏、藤堂の恋人・林美奈役で美村里江が共演。
